_comment: PRIMARY enhancement: short-term queue FORECAST (E8), the vision-only analogue
of Wei et al.'s (2025 TITS) predictive queue-dynamics control.
The controller acts on where each approach's queue is HEADING, not only where it
stands: QueuePredictor fits the recent trend of normalized_queue and projects it
forecast_horizon_seconds ahead. That forecast enters the Score at forecast_weight
(omega = 0.4) and pre-sizes the discharge-limited green, and gap-out ends a green
once its queue actually clears. Together this grants green before a queue spills
back rather than after it has formed.
Supporting Li et al. (2025 TITS) mechanisms are on underneath: use_pce_queue (E1),
use_discharge_green (E3, with the Eq. 7 lost-time term), use_gap_out (E6). E5
over-saturation measurement and E7 stop counting are always recorded.
No MPC, no link-transmission model, no solver: a least-squares trend line over a
0.5 s window (forecast_window_frames 15 at 30 fps) feeding the existing controller.
